text:
kai: Hey team — idea: Ramen roulette + mini-arcade run next Friday. Start at 5:30 for ramen (three nearby spots, rotate), then head to The Arcade Bar around 8. Anyone in? :ramen::joystick:

mina: love it. Ramen before arcade sounds perfect. I'm in but need a veggie option.

owen: count me in. can we set a spending cap? $25ish?

ruth: in! bringing a friend. also can we do a quick poll for ramen heat levels so no accidental lava bowls :sweat_smile:

sam: i'm game. also volunteer to coordinate the timed slots—first place fits 12 people only.

danielle: small ask: accessible seating at The Arcade Bar? one of my friends uses a wheelchair.

kai: good call. pinging facilities in case we need to request accessibility notes. @facilities any heads-up?

facilities: The Arcade Bar has ramp access and an accessible restroom. We can check table layout and reserve near the entrance. For venue tabs, attach receipts for reimbursement.

mina: ok cool. i'll add a line on the RSVP for accessibility.

kai: quick react poll: :one: spicy, :two: mild, :three: mixed. react to vote. Poll closes Wed 4pm.

owen: :three: mixed so folks can pick.

ruth: :two: mild for me.

sam: also adding a sheet: https://tiny.redwood/ramen-arcade-rsvp  add dish prefs, plus-ones, and whether you want to join arcade only.

danielle: RSVP +1 (bringing Jordan). added. thanks for thinking about accessibility.

kai: thinking suggested split $20-30 pp for food + a $10 optional arcade card. if finance okay with small pooled tab, ops-bot please advise.

ops-bot: For team-socials events: small pooled tabs are allowed. Submit `/expense submit --amount <total> --category team-socials --notes "ramen roulette arcade"`. Reimbursements require receipts and attendees list.

mina: heads-up: I'm allergic to sesame. i'll mark it on the sheet.

own: volunteers for signpost at each ramen spot (to manage timed groups)? react :hand: if you can.

sam: :hand: happy to help with signups and timing.

danielle: i'll bring a small first-aid kit and allergy cards.

kai: awesome. if majority prefers earlier start i'll do 5:15 so we have more time before the arcade. react :clock: if earlier works.

own: earlier is better for me. :clock:

ruth: earlier works. my friend's on a tight schedule.

mina: earlier ok too.

sam: noted—moving to 5:15 unless objections.

facilities: If you want a reserved lane at Arcade Bar for prize games, request 72h in advance. We can coordinate.

kai: fun—maybe mini tournament for pinball with cheap prizes (stickers + a $5 coffee card). react :trophy: if you like prizes.

own: :trophy: yes please

danielle: :trophy: cute idea.

mina: small ask: transit late-night options? I might head home early.

sam: metro runs until ~1am on Fridays but check schedule. there's also a rideshare hub by the plaza.

kai: final checklist: add RSVP to sheet, mark allergies/accessibility, submit expenses if chipping in, volunteers for signposting + setup. Arcade tab optional. See you next Friday — ramen first then games! :game_die:
